A '''Hydraulic shearing machine''' was a machine that was used in the field of genetics. [[Reye Nenilin]] said that he would buy one after [[Kal Skirata]] gave him some of [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai's]] genetics data, to try and get him to create a cure to stop the premature aging of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]].
